verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents API tokens that can be limited to specific resources and permission levels. Its example: Zone DNS Read on example.com lets the token read DNS records only for that zone. Templates are also documented. For agents specifically, the official MCP server uses OAuth where you select which permissions to grant your agent, and it also accepts scoped user or account API tokens for automation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and documentation of token expiry/TTL and revocation for agent credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: granting Zone DNS Read access to a zone example.com will allow the token to read DNS records only for that specific zone
Select which resources the token is authorized to access.
After selecting a permissions group (Account, User, or Zone), choose what level of access to grant the token.
you will be redirected to Cloudflare to authorize via OAuth and select the permissions to grant to your agent
you can create a Cloudflare API token with the permissions you need and pass it as a bearer token in the Authorization header. Both user tokens and account tokens are supported.
